plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla and an American inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown both found the same hidden physics, which Michels calls extended electrodynamics, a broader form of the science of electricity and magnetism that he says often involves "high voltages across short distances." Michels says this himself on three episodes, once adding that Tesla did this late in his career at his labs at Wardenclyffe and in Colorado Springs, and once, without mentioning Tesla, saying he is as sure of Brown as of anything in the story and that "it seems like that's how the crafts fly." If true, it would mean the way UFOs move was already glimpsed by these two inventors.
